proof: Every untouched clause in F not containing v or -v has width at most 3.
A positive parent has the form (v OR A) with |A|<=2; a negative parent has the form (-v OR B) with |B|<=2.
Their raw resolvent is A UNION B, hence has size at most |A|+|B|<=4 before tautology/duplicate simplification.
Discarding tautological resolvents cannot increase width.
Canonical duplicate collapse and subsumption/minimization cannot increase width.
Therefore every clause in the exact raw DP output has width <=4.
important_nonclaims: This does not prove that exact DP on a width-4 state stays width-4; raw resolvents can have width up to 6.
This does not prove that R47J/R42 normalization preserves persisted width <=4.
This does not prove O4, SAT_IN_P, P=NP, or P!=NP.
